chat.peerDelivery: one authenticated local SDK send while the parent thread remained open

directory.limitation: Archived conversations are seeded history; the two new messages were sent through the app.

multiSeatSdk.limitation: The booking request used the native gateway; approval and cancellation used authenticated local service calls, not UI.

tripChanges.limitation: Price proposals, consent, refusal and withdrawal only; no route calculation, application, payment or physical-device proof.

tripChangeInputs.limitation: Departure time and price consent, unresolved-address rejection and failed route request only; no successful place lookup, route change, application, payment or physical-device proof.

tripSchedule.limitation: Date and desired-arrival consent plus cancelled/past/invalid drafts only; no route change, application, payment, physical tracking or post-restart consent proof.

tripConsentRestart.limitation: Confirmed single-parent price consent after process death only; no pending/refused/withdrawn proposal recovery, unsent drafts, application, route, real payment or physical-device proof.

tripConsentRecovery.limitation: Pending, partial, refused and withdrawn price proposals after a new process, including closed history for both parents and driver. No unsent drafts, application, real routes/payments or physical-device proof.

tripDraftRestart.limitation: Driver raw price and unresolved addresses across a guarded new local app process; second trip stays empty. No physical-device, iOS, cross-device sync, route/application or payment proof.

tripScheduleDraftRestart.limitation: Valid unsubmitted date, departure time and desired arrival across a new local app process. No physical-device, iOS, route/application or payment proof.

membershipRefresh.limitation: Manager decisions use authenticated local SDK calls, not a mobile management UI.

limits: Network disabled before the first attempt, not after a server commit.
No process restart, token expiry, physical device or push delivery tested.
Confirmed messages only; pending or unsent draft recovery is not tested.
No physical device, token expiry, post-commit acknowledgement loss or push delivery tested.
Production conversation route and SDK, hosted in a test activity; not full app navigation.
Controlled local HTTP reply loss and 429 rejection, with Firestore network paused to defer its acknowledgement.
No operating-system network loss, physical phone, process restart, expired token or push delivery tested.

search.limitation: The four search UI cases use explicit fake gateways and host identity/navigation changes, not real provider matching.

limits: Synthetic mock positions and pre-granted emulator permissions only.
No physical GPS tracking, provider payments, push delivery or live data tested.
